name: attendsmart-ai
description: Location-aware Bluetooth attendance with a final class register, permanent posting and analytics for universities.

scripts.mobile:student: node tools/build-mobile.js && cd native/student && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:lecturer: node tools/build-mobile.js && cd native/lecturer && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open:student: npm run mobile:student && cd native/student && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:open:lecturer: npm run mobile:lecturer && cd native/lecturer && npx cap open android
